comments.author: Sophia
comments.body: The ship feels slow because it is slow. Water resistance is mentioned when you build/improve a ship but the exact effects aren't documented. Opinions on it range from absolute gospel fact to complete myth/not implemented(yet). Personally I would not take it past maximum effective range. The damage it does to the stats can be overcome, but it will never be as good as it could have been if you had simply just gone to max effective stats.
